intro: Kaltunk is an orc overseer stationed at the heart of the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He serves as the very first point of contact for young orcs taking their opening steps into the world. It is his duty to welcome these aspiring champions and direct them to their initial duties in service to the Horde.

p: Standing under the harsh sun of the Valley of Trials, Kaltunk watches over the newly arrived hopefuls seeking to prove themselves worthy of the Horde. While other trainers and elders assign grueling trials and hunting rites, Kaltunk ensures that no recruit wanders aimlessly through the red dust. He delivers straightforward orders, pointing newcomers directly toward Gornek and the path of discipline.

The Valley of Trials is not an easy proving ground; it was chosen specifically to forge strength and resilience in every youth who walks its canyon floors. Kaltunk embodies this rugged practicality. He offers no grand speeches or coddling, expecting each orc to quickly find their place in the world and pull their weight for the warchief.
